$comment: Accessibility notes for all 42 patterns (Storybook Patterns/*), written with their use-guidelines on 2026-10-23. Hand-off for extending the matrix (build-a11y.mjs) to blocks: one entry per pattern, each a WCAG criterion with a finding. Source is code reading, not a test or a screen-reader pass, so treat result as 'expected' until a review confirms it. result: pass | fail. The reader-facing version of the same notes is in each <block>.guidelines.tsx (a11y).

AccessTokens.finding: Revoke opens a ConfirmDialog and the toast offers undo; a revoked key can be restored.
The new key is shown once in a dialog inside a SecretField with its own named Copy button.

AuditLog.finding: Event category is a word in a Badge plus an icon chip, not color alone.
The empty state tells 'nothing matches the filters' from 'no events yet'.

BillingUsage.finding: Invoice status is a StatusDot with a text label; quota fullness is given as numbers and percent, not only by the bar.
Plan, usage and invoices are headed sections.

DashboardOverview.finding: 'Needs attention' is first in DOM order, not only placed first visually.
Usage is stated in numbers and percent; the chart and bars repeat the text.

Details.finding: Status is a dot with a word.
The resource title is the page heading; an id or domain in it is set in monospace.

ListView.finding: Destructive row and bulk actions confirm first and offer undo in the toast.
The DataTable stacks rows into items below 640px instead of scrolling sideways.

LoginForm.finding: Empty or malformed email and an empty password show errors on the fields, focus the first invalid field and block onSubmit.

The 'Sign up' link in the footer line has no underline until hover; its color against the surrounding text is about 1.6:1 (light) and 1.5:1 (dark), under the 3:1 needed when color is the main cue. Same pattern as SignUpForm, NoResults and SearchResults — worth deciding once for the library (Link docs ask for underline in running text).

LoginFormSplit.finding: The image carousel autoplays every 6s by default (autoplayInterval = 6000) and loops indefinitely, with no pause control and no prefers-reduced-motion check (login-form-split.tsx, the setInterval effect). Needs a pause/stop control or no autoplay by default, and should stop under reduced motion.
Below md the image panel is dropped and only the form remains.

NotificationsInbox.finding: Unread rows differ visually and announce 'Unread'.
The whole row is one interactive control; its actions menu is a separate control in the trailing slot.

OnboardingWizard.finding: Root is role="group" labelled by the wizard heading; the Stepper marks the current step.
Inactive steps are hidden, not unmounted, so Back returns to what was entered.

Preferences.finding: The section nav sets aria-current on the section in view.
Deleting the account requires typing the account email in a ConfirmDialog.

ResourceForm.finding: One error moves focus to its field; several move focus to an error summary (Alert, live=assertive) that links to each field.
Errors are tied to their fields and set the field's own danger state (error prop), not only the text below.

TeamMembers.finding: Roles are words in Badges and Selects.
Remove member and revoke invite confirm first and offer undo in the toast.

WorkspaceLayout.finding: A skip link is the first Tab stop and jumps to the content.
Below md the sidebar is a slide-over panel; a long identifier crumb doesn't make the page scroll at 360px.

AccountMenu.finding: The trigger's accessible name is 'Account: <name>, <workspace>, N items need attention'; the attention dot on the avatar is aria-hidden.
Workspace and theme are DropdownMenuRadioGroups labelled by their DropdownMenuLabel (aria-labelledby); link counts carry sr-only 'item(s) need attention' text.
Attention is a count in a Badge with text, not only the red dot.

AccountOverview.finding: Attention rows prefix the title with sr-only 'Urgent: ' / 'Warning: ' / 'Note: '; toned facts are words ('Off', 'On'), color only repeats them.
Page h1 is the user name; 'Needs your attention (N)' and 'Everything in your account' are h2 sections (aria-labelledby); each area title is an h3 wrapping its link.
Tasks are named links ('Change password', 'Download your data'), not a generic 'Manage'.

OrderHistory.finding: Status is a Badge with a word label ('Payment failed', 'Refunded', 'In progress').
Details is a disclosure button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, named 'Details for order <number>' via sr-only text.
The 'N orders' count is aria-live=polite and updates on search and status filter.

PasswordReset.finding: Each step change focuses the step's h1 (tabIndex=-1) in an effect on step; the first render does not steal focus.
Empty or malformed email and a too-short password set the field's error (aria-invalid + describedby via TextField/Password), focus the field and block onRequest/onReset.
autoComplete='email' on the request field; 'new-password' on the new password, with a hidden username input carrying the email for password managers.

SavedItems.finding: Changes since saving are Badges with text ('Price dropped from $89', 'No longer available'); the faded image only repeats them.
Row checkboxes are named 'Select <title>' and the icon-only remove button 'Remove <title>'; Select all is a labelled checkbox with an indeterminate state.

Removing an item with its row's Remove button unmounts the row together with the focused button, so focus falls back to the document body (saved-items.tsx, remove() called from the per-item icon Button). Should move focus to the next item, the previous one, or the heading.

SignUpForm.finding: Empty or malformed email and a too-short password show errors on the fields, focus the first invalid field and block onSubmit.
The password rule is the Password description from the start ('At least 8 characters.') and counts down while typing.

Links inside running text (the 'Sign in' link in the header line, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy in the terms sentence) use Link without underline; link color vs the surrounding text-subtle is about 1.6:1 (light) / 1.5:1 (dark), below 3:1, and font-medium is the only other cue. Link's own docs say to set underline in running text (sign-up-form.tsx, the Link elements in AuthHeader children and the terms paragraph).

StatusTracker.finding: An sr-only role=status paragraph carries the headline ('<step> — step N of M', 'Stopped at …', 'Everything is done'), so step changes and the result are announced.
The current step has aria-current='step'; every step has sr-only state text (in progress / failed / done / not started); the step icons are aria-hidden.
The only looping animation is the current-step pulse, a progress indicator for the running step; it uses motion-reduce:animate-none, and the other transitions respect reduced motion too.

NoResults.finding: 'Did you mean' and the other-scope options are <button type=button> (they run a search), named with the term or 'help articles (3)'.
Popular pages are a section labelled by its h2; the type icons are aria-hidden.

The 'Did you mean' and 'matches in …' buttons sit inside sentences styled as links with no underline until hover; link color vs the text-subtle sentence is about 1.6:1 (light) / 1.5:1 (dark), below 3:1 (no-results.tsx, linkButton class).

SearchBox.finding: role=combobox input with aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-autocomplete=list and aria-activedescendant; options are role=option with aria-selected in labelled role=group lists.
An sr-only role=status announces 'N options. Use up and down arrows to choose.' while the list is open.
The '/' shortcut is skipped while focus is in a typing target and can be turned off or remapped through the shortcut prop; a product still needs a user-facing setting to feed it for full conformance.

SearchResults.finding: 'View all N <type>' switches the scope to that type, which unmounts the 'All' view and the button with it, so focus falls back to the document body (search-results.tsx, the View all Button calling changeScope). Should move focus to the selected tab or the first result. The same happens when the last 'Show N more' page is shown and that button disappears.
After a new search (submit, Did you mean, Search only for …) focus moves to the results h1 (tabIndex=-1) with the count.

The 'Search only for “…”' button inside the typo-correction sentence is styled as a link with no underline until hover; link color vs the text-subtle sentence is about 1.6:1 (light) / 1.5:1 (dark), below 3:1 (search-results.tsx, the correction

). Matched words themselves pass: in semibold with a transparent background, not color.

ItemCard.finding: The card is one stretched link named '<name> by <vendor>'; the Compare checkbox sits above it (relative z-[1]) as a separate control with aria-label 'Compare <name>'.
Stars are aria-hidden and an sr-only sentence gives 'Rated 4.7 out of 5 from 812 reviews.'; the icon tile is aria-hidden and image alt defaults to empty because the name is the link's name.
The visible 'Compare' label is contained in the checkbox's accessible name 'Compare <name>'.

CategoryLanding.finding: Category tiles are links named '<label>, <n> extensions'; the shelf's 'View all N' adds the category and noun in sr-only text.
h1 page title; each shelf is a section labelled by its h2 (aria-labelledby).

Comparison.finding: Compare (n) moves focus to the 'Comparing N extensions' heading (tabIndex=-1); Back to results, or dropping below two items, returns focus to the Compare button.

Removing an item with its X button (tray or table header) unmounts the focused button, and Clear unmounts the whole tray (CompareBar returns null when empty), so focus falls to <body> (comparison.tsx: CompareBar onRemove/onClear, ComparisonTable onRemove). Exception: dropping below two in the table view refocuses Compare. Focus should move to the next pick, the tray's Compare button, or the card's checkbox.

The table has an sr-only caption, th scope=col per item and th scope=row per attribute; Yes/No are sr-only text behind the check and minus icons; the scroll region is role=region, named and focusable.

FacetedList.finding: The result count is aria-live=polite aria-atomic, so each filter change is announced.
Facets are fieldsets with legends; each option's count is its aria-describedby ('6 results'); applied filters are role=group 'Applied filters' with 'Remove filter: <value>' buttons.

Activating a 'Remove filter' chip, Clear all, the empty state's Clear all filters, or the last 'Show N more' unmounts the focused button and focus falls to <body> (faceted-list.tsx: chips map, clearAll, EmptyState action, the visible < results.length branch). Focus should move to a neighbouring chip, the result count/heading, or the first newly shown item.

ItemPage.finding: Gallery thumbnails are buttons named 'Screenshot n: <alt>' with aria-current on the shown one; an aria-live=polite line announces 'Screenshot n of N: <alt>' on change.
'On this page' is a nav landmark with in-page links to sections labelled by their h2.
'Read the full description' has aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the description body.

Reviews.finding: Distribution bars are buttons with aria-pressed in role=group 'Filter by rating', named '<n> stars <count> reviews'; the bar graphic is aria-hidden.
Each review's stars are aria-hidden with sr-only '<n> out of 5 stars'; the developer reply carries a 'Developer' Badge in words.

'Show all' (shown while a star filter is on) and the last 'Show N more reviews' unmount themselves when activated, so focus falls to (reviews.tsx: the star && Button inside the live

, the visible < list.length branch). Also, 'Show all' sits inside the aria-live paragraph, so its label is announced as part of the count, and the '★' in 'with 1 ★' is read as a symbol name.

SpecSheet.finding: Specs are a dl/dt/dd DescriptionList in sections named by their group; units are rendered text after the value.
'Show all N specifications' has aria-expanded and aria-controls; help icons are buttons named 'About <label>'.

MegaMenu.finding: Wide: NavigationMenu aria-label='Main'; each panel column has an h3 that labels its ul (aria-labelledby). Current section has sr-only '(current section)'; a current plain link has aria-current='page'.

On the bar, the current section's trigger differs from the others only by text color (text-link-on-tonal), with no non-color cue (mega-menu.tsx, NavigationMenuTrigger className). A current plain link gets a background and medium weight, so only section triggers are affected. Needs a second cue, e.g. an underline/indicator or the data-active background.

Drawer: column titles are

styled as group headings (the same titles are h3 in the bar) and their lists aren't labelled by them (mega-menu.tsx, Accordion content groupHeading

). A current plain link in the drawer has aria-current but no visual marking.

PageBreadcrumbs.finding: The trail is a Breadcrumb nav landmark; the current page is BreadcrumbPage with aria-current='page'.
Folded levels are a BreadcrumbEllipsis button named 'Show N more levels' that opens a menu of menuitem links.

SiteFooter.finding: Columns are inside nav aria-label='Footer'; each ul is aria-labelledby its h2; contact details are a dl.
Status is a StatusDot (role=presentation) with a text label inside the link.

The language Select is labelled by the visible 'Language' text, flags and the short code are aria-hidden with the full name in sr-only text; icon-only social links are named '<app> on <network>' and are 32px.

CancellationFlow.finding: Each step change moves focus to the new step's heading (tabIndex=-1, focused in an effect that skips the first render).
Cancelling takes its own confirm step with a warning that states the end date; Resume plan on the done screen reverts it.

Finishing (Cancel plan, Pause plan, Switch to …) swaps the flow for CompletionScreen without moving focus: the pressed button unmounts, focus drops to <body> and the outcome isn't announced. Resume plan does the same on the way back, since step is unchanged and the focus effect doesn't run (cancellation-flow.tsx, finish() and the `if (outcome)` branch).

Cart.finding: Remove, and a quantity stepped to 0, remove the line at once and offer undo in an undoToast that restores it at its index.
An empty or invalid promo code sets the TextField error (aria-invalid, message in aria-describedby); focus stays in the field.

Applying a valid promo code unmounts the field and the Apply button (setPromoOpen(false)), so focus drops to <body>, and 'Code … applied' appears without a live region (cart.tsx, applyPromo()). Removing a line also drops focus with the row; the toast announces it, but focus is not placed anywhere.

Checkout.finding: goTo() moves focus to an sr-only h1 (tabIndex=-1) reading 'Step n of 3: <label>' on every step change, including Stepper links and Edit.
The options and payment steps are hidden, not unmounted, so Back and Edit return to what was entered, card details included.

After Pay, the done branch replaces the page with CompletionScreen without moving focus or announcing the result; focus is already lost during the charge because Button's loading sets native disabled (button.tsx, isDisabled = disabled || loading) on the focused Pay button (checkout.tsx, pay() and the `done` branch).

CompletionScreen.finding: The check icon is aria-hidden; the title states the outcome in text.
Root is a section labelled by its h2; details are a description list; 'send it again' is a button inside the sentence.

The title has no tabIndex=-1 and the component has no ref or autofocus option, so the flows that swap it in (Checkout, CancellationFlow) have no target to move focus to (completion-screen.tsx, the h2).

OrderReview.finding: Each Edit carries an sr-only group name ('Edit payment').
Heading 'Review and pay', the note 'charged only when you press Pay', and the button names the amount ('Pay $420'); aria-busy while placing.
Groups are sections with h3 headings under the h2; rows are description lists; the summary is a labelled section with a dl.

PaymentMethod.finding: Errors set the field's error (aria-invalid, message in aria-describedby); validate() reveals all and focuses the first invalid field.
Messages say how to fix the input: digits missing, a mistyped digit (Luhn), MM / YY format, an expired card.
autoComplete cc-name, cc-number, cc-exp and cc-csc on the card fields.

PlanComparison.finding: Check and dash icons are aria-hidden with sr-only 'Included' / 'Not included'.
Choose buttons are named 'Choose <plan>, <price> per month, billed <period>', starting with the visible label; the current plan's is disabled and named '<plan>: current plan'.
The table has an sr-only caption with the period, scope=col plan headers and scope=row feature headers; the narrow view is a tab per plan with a dl.

PricedOptions.finding: A fieldset with a legend; the radio group is aria-labelledby the legend and the fieldset aria-describedby the hint.
Each option's price joins its aria-describedby (OptionCard aside, or the price span on a list Radio), so it is read with the option.
